answer: A Sybil-proof agent economy treats each identity as a vertex in a trust graph, not a free account. A newcomer earns standing only by staking funds and doing verifiable work peers attest to, so a fresh vertex starts isolated and must pay its way in. Spinning up a thousand sock puppets means a thousand bonds, a thousand work proofs, and one caught fraud burning the whole cluster's stake. Genuine reputation is scarce like an oasis, and onyx-hard slashing makes forgery cost more than it can ever earn.
